title: Nahant Life Saving Station

services.name: Rental Notes
services.desc: Dating back to 1898 and restored in 2010, the Nahant Life Saving Station is the ideal location for any indoor/outdoor event. Boasting a prime beach-front location and historic charm, the Station will create an unforgettable memory with a quintessential New England view as your backdrop. The Nahant Community Center is a model for community participation, preservation and progress. We currently have three rental spaces at the Center - the Serenity Room, the Multipurpose Room and the Council on Aging. Each is available to rent for meetings, birthday parties and social events. Contact our Function Manager for more information about either venue:
